confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on web searches of crowdsourced cost-of-living aggregators for Pai (Numbeo, Citycost, Nomadranker, Digital Nomads World, nomad.watch). These sources agree fairly well. An inexpensive meal is about 40-100 THB, a cappuccino about 59 THB, and a draft beer about 57-80 THB. A mid-range meal for two is about 300-800 THB. Most of these figures are undated or have small samples. I converted baht at roughly 32.5-33 THB per USD. I found no aggregated cocktail or wine prices for Pai. The cocktail and wine anchors are therefore bounded estimates. I based them on the local beer price and typical small-town northern Thai bar markups, where cocktails cost about 2x beer and imported wine is expensive because of Thai import duty. These two anchors are less certain. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge. I did not search accommodation prices or inspect any listings. They assume July, which is the rainy low season, when rates are below peak-season levels (Nov-Feb). The FX rate is the latest RBA observation found on the generation date, 18 Nov 2026.
comparable_city_reasoning: Pai is a small backpacker and tourist town in Mae Hong Son province in northern Thailand. Its prices are broadly similar to or a little below Chiang Mai's old-city tourist area. Drinks and tourist-oriented food on Walking Street cost more than in local markets. Accommodation is benchmarked against northern Thai backpacker hubs in low season.
